page_title: LEV 2-0 FRE | Bayer Leverkusen v Freiburg 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+3' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bayer Leverkusen are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Harm Osmers has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
85' Julian Schuster prepares a substitution. Lucas Holer is replaced by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg).
85' The game has come to an end for Ernest Poku. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Eliesse Ben Seghir (Bayer Leverkusen).
84' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
82' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
79' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
77' Derry Scherhant goes off the pitch and Christian Gunter (Freiburg) comes on.
77' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to make a change. Jeanuel Belocian (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Jarell Quansah.
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Christian Michel Kofane as he is replaced by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen).
76' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
76' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
75' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) will take the free kick.
74' Harm Osmers blows his whistle and Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
72' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 64:36.
72' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
67' Substitution. Lukas Kubler leaves the pitch and is replaced by Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg).
67' Today's match ends for Johan Manzambi who will be replaced by Igor Matanovic (Freiburg).
67' Kasper Hjulmand decides to make a substitution. Jonas Hofmann will be replaced by Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen).
67' Substitution. Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) in, Ezequiel Fernandez out.
64' The corner from Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) is intercepted by the defence.

59' Freiburg are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
55' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the right post.

52' 2 - 0 A perfect lofted pass from Alejandro Grimaldo finds Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the top right corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Noah Atubolu had no chance of stopping that. 2:0.
51' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner with a short pass.
51' Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
51' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
50' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
48' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashed a promising volley from the edge of the box, but he narrowly misses the target as his shot goes over the bar.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Julian Schuster probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Junior Adamu. He is replaced by Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) trips an opposition player and Harm Osmers signals a foul.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Freiburg showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
40' Close effort! Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) takes the resulting free kick from a promising distance, but he sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
38' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
34' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
30' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Bayer Leverkusen! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Harm Osmers and both teams have no complaints.

30' Play continues despite the shouts by some Bayer Leverkusen players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Harm Osmers interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
26' Wonderful movement by Freiburg. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

22' 1 - 0 It's in! Aleix Garcia spots his teammate in a good position on the edge of the box and provides him with a nice pass. Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) doesn't think twice and rifles a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. The score is now 1:0.
20' Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
20' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
17' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

17' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Noah Atubolu to dive and make a save. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. They send men into the box.
15' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Harm Osmers had an easy-decision to make.
10' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
6' Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
4' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

4' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Mark Flekken, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. It will be a corner kick for Freiburg.
3' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the left post. What a poor effort.
3' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) will deliver the corner kick.

2' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Mark Flekken made a crucial save!
2' Freiburg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Freiburg will kick the game off.
Harm Osmers will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
